sections.title: 1. Core Study Notes
sections.content:
Geography

  • Empire stretched from Hindukush to Mysore.
  • Key provinces: Taxila, Ujjain, Tosali, Suvarnagiri.

Personalities

  • Ashoka: The Philosopher King.
  • Upagupta: Buddhist monk who influenced Ashoka.
  • Brihadratha: Last Mauryan ruler.

Core Concepts Overview

  • Dhamma Policy:
    • Tolerance, non-violence (Ahimsa), and respect for elders/Brahmins/Sramanas.
    • Dhamma Mahamattas: Officers appointed to propagate ethical behavior.
  • Successors:
    • Kunala, Dasharatha, and Samprati.
    • Weak centralized control led to fragmentation.
